mapper.insert: insert into sys_webhook_path_index (path, tenant_id, workflow_id, node_id, workflow_name, created_at, updated_at) values (#{path}, #{tenantId}, #{workflowId}, #{nodeId}, #{workflowName}, now(), now()) on conflict (path) do update set tenant_id = excluded.tenant_id, workflow_id = excluded.workflow_id, node_id = excluded.node_id, workflow_name = excluded.workflow_name, updated_at = now()
